code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            rr, cc = n - 1 - r, m - 1 - c
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[rr][cc] == 0:
                out[rr][cc] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
